Page 244 Nov. 12 Dr. M. King - 35 - fell from 2nd floor .... fracture of skull feared 12 Neil Fraley - 35 - heart trouble; has wife and 8 children depending. Julia O'Connor - 57 - Special intention - seemingly anxious Mr. Bloon - 63 - lukemia in Women's Hospital - Hopeless last week - decidedly improved.
13
Mrs. George .... Hopeless last week - improving - stomach cancer Stanley Doll Brighter To-day xray this a.m. indicates 2nd mastoid. Drs decide to wait with opera- tion tomorrow .... improved since yest.
Henry Martin (again) water on brain - 15 ounces
Francis Chester - 67 - stroke - poorly -
Josephine Gerard - 96 - fell last night - complains of pains in Chest ... at ... Strawberry lake.
Ida Weingarts - 51 - inward goitre ...
Page 245 Nov. 14 Walter Sobcjzk - 7 - quite abnormal - had convulsions three yrs. ago. - not well since; parents married in court - never had their union blessed.
Michael Nagle - 78 - in Harper H. - has been away from Sacraments many yrs .... His father ask for prayers
Alexander Mulhern - 69 presbiterian - Throat cancer - taken from Re- ceiving to Eloise .... Enrolled.
Mr. Hosty and elderly man - very sick since July. Case of heart and kidney ailment - seems hopeless.
Mrs. Florence Bergin - 48 - full of cancer; operation for tuomer five yrs. ago. - proved malignant ....
Thanks - Mrs. Mary Sroka - 45 - in fearful accident - skull fractured - limbs broken. Drs. absolutely hopeless. In perfect condition
Mary Churilla - 33 - cronic apend. - fears operation .. .
